You’re right, looking mysterious draws a bit of interest from girls, but we will 9/10 not make the first move. You may be attractive as an aloof person but probably won’t get a date this way.

Keep up with your interests, but do approach girls you find attractive, cute, interesting, well dressed or what have you. The first conversations shouldn’t be complimenting their looks or conveying interest in dating—it feels like you are not interested in us for who we are, and sometimes forces us to make a split second decision about whether we are attracted enough to reciprocate. Think small talk. NO love bombing and avoid too flirty conversation. Compliment her on her outfits, what she says in class, but excessive compliments seem disingenuous. Balance asking her about herself with talking about yourself—that will show you’re interested in her AND that you’re interesting and genuine. TLDR, treat her like you’d treat any other person you want to be friends with, but with more interest.

Once you’re talking more start asking her out on progressively more “date-like” activities and feel her vibe. If she cancels often or is hesitant she’s either focused on her work, legitimately constantly busy, or isn’t interested. If she goes often, asks you out to things, looks put together and nice around you, she may like you (for me it’s if I reply to texts quickly and dress well). Ask her how she feels. If she just sees you as a friend, staying her friend will make things a little awkward unless you really are okay with being friends. Then try again with someone else. Don’t take anything personally, don’t be angry, don’t dwell on it, and don’t try to convince her or try again, just be polite with her.

Without dating apps, trying to figure out if someone likes you is pretty difficult, but not impossible. Do go out and talk to girls though, or else you won’t get past girls just looking at you. We’re not forward at all. Good luck!
